name: bertopia-room-server
description: Phase 0 class room server for Bertopia: presence only (alias nameplates + positions). Standalone. Not wired into the game.

scripts.test: node --import ./test/shim/register.mjs --test "test/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:host && npm run test:home
scripts.test:home: node --no-warnings tools/home-page-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-join-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-owner-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-rules-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-fuzz-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-spam-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-play-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-pack-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-launch-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-launcher-py-check.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/home-share-check.mjs
